You couldn't break it at all...? ...Then we need a more powerful drill.
Hey, speaking of drills... We've got that one we picked up earlier, right?
What is it?
Ankh and the others handed over the "Broken Zeroliner Drill" they had found at the quarry.
Oh... It's the Zeroliner's drill. Which means it's made of Den-Metal, right?
All right, I'll try repairing it. If it works out, we can equip it on the Ride Machine.
Give me a little time.
As for us, we'll deal with the enemy in front of us first.
Yapool and Ikadevil, huh...

notes.note: #0.51-0.54 finish the 13-slot block from story_063 (Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00); identical source -> 'Where are they?' as in 063.

#0.64-0.76 and #0.79-0.91 follow the 0358.bla Pt_Chara_Check order 15,14,11,12,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10: Zero, Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O (Momotaros), W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Wording fits (#0.65 polite Mebius, #0.69 exclaiming RX, #0.70 rough Momotaros, #0.72 polite OOO). 'Taisei wo totonoeru' = regroup. Source pairs differing only by a comma (#0.68/#0.71, #0.88-0.91) share one English line.

Zero (#0.79) and slot 5 (#0.83, Rider 1 by the order, though the casual 'ze' is unusual for him) call him plain 'Zoffy'; Mebius, Ultraman and Seven say 'Zoffy-niisan' = 'Brother Zoffy' as in story_063. #0.79 lacks 'our', #0.83 has it; kept that difference.

#0.97-0.151 are not played by 0358.bla (script ends at #0.92). Speakers taken from the parallel base scene MainEventMess0913 (speakers.json): #0.106 Zoffy, #0.107 Seravee, #0.108 Zoffy, #0.109 Hikari, #0.110 Seravee, #0.111/113/115-117 Hikari, #0.112 Ankh, #0.119 Nu Gundam, #0.120/122 W (Shotaro), #0.121/123/125/126 Zoffy, #0.124 Den-O Sword (Momotaros). Second variant #0.136-0.151 assumed to mirror it (0913 labels #0.141/142/144 Hikari, #0.143 Zoffy, #0.150 Momotaros).
Narration 'darou' kept as a prediction: 'will surely be'. 'Based on knowledge and experience' compressed to 'seasoned, well-informed' to fit two lines. Zoffy is male per glossary ('His').
Ankh means the drill found at the quarry in story_060 (0342), which Momotaros picked up.
Item name matches story_060 0343 #0.2: "Broken Zeroliner Drill".
Same line as 0343 #0.4 (story_060); same English, incl. 'Den-Metal' (not in glossary).
Nu Gundam (Amuro): 'we' = the heroes in the field, as opposed to Hikari working on the drill; subject and verb restored.
Yapool referred to as 'he' (glossary Giant Yapool g=m).
Zoffy; 'kakatte kure' = go at the enemy; 'him' = Yapool from the previous line.
'Fumei da' (vs 'wakaranai' in #0.123) rendered more formally: 'That remains unknown.'
Ace Killer's exhaled breath/groan, not a laugh.

0359 leader order (per story_065): Mebius, Zero, Ultraman, Seven, Rider 1, RX, Den-O (Momotaros), W... #0.3 Zero and #0.8 Momotaros use the rough 'yagatta' form; identical rows match story_065's 'You've been revived!?'.

report: 80/80 examined. Base-scene rows #0.97-0.151 (not played by 0358.bla) voiced from the MainEventMess0913 parallel speakers; second variant #0.136-0.151 assumed to mirror it. #0.83 slot 5 (Rider 1) uses casual 'ze'. 'Den-Metal' and 'Zeroliner Drill' not in glossary (follow story_060).
